generated.details: At mid-right on the desk, beside and clearly separated from the laptop, place a palm-sized solid-color geometric puzzle cube with matte ivory interlocking blocks, narrow dividing seams and aligned flat faces.
Its continuous troweled surface has shallow irregular ridges and subtle tonal variation.
At the far-right desk-wall junction, the concealed RGB strip sits inside a recessed channel whose lip hides the diodes.
Higher on the right wall, a continuous non-text neon tube bends into an open angular line, held slightly off the plaster by discreet mounts.
